_note: One shared definition per term, used by every ⓘ tooltip. {placeholders} are filled from accounts.json so numbers always match the pipeline.

account.label: Account
account.text: A customer company, as it appears in Salesforce.

segment.label: Segment
segment.text: Customer size band: Enterprise, Mid-Market or Commercial.

rank.label: Rank
rank.text: Position among all {total_accounts} accounts, sorted by expected value. #1 is worth the most time.

propensity_score.label: Propensity score
propensity_score.text: 0–100 score for how likely a customer is to grow soon if we invest technical time.

top_reasons.label: Top reasons
top_reasons.text: The three signals that added the most points to the score, in plain English.

pool_of_funds.label: Pool of funds
pool_of_funds.text: Money available to unlock: unused commit plus open pipeline.

unused_commit.label: Unused commit
unused_commit.text: Spend the customer already committed to but hasn't used yet. Helping them use it protects the renewal.

open_pipeline.label: Open pipeline
open_pipeline.text: Expansion deals currently open in Salesforce for this customer.

expected_value.label: Expected value
expected_value.text: Score ÷ 100 × pool of funds. The money we can realistically help unlock.

ev_covered.label: Expected value covered
ev_covered.text: Expected value of the accounts that fit within current SA/FDE capacity.

annual_commit.label: Annual commit
annual_commit.text: What the customer contracted to spend this year.

consumed.label: Consumed
consumed.text: Commit used so far, and how that compares with the expected pace for this point in the contract.

burn_pace.label: Burn pace
burn_pace.text: Commit used vs. expected by now. 100% = on schedule; 50% = using it at half the expected rate.

usage_growth.label: Usage growth
usage_growth.text: Change in product usage over the last {win_usage} days vs. the {win_usage} days before.

new_developers.label: New developers
new_developers.text: Developers who started using the platform at this customer in the last {win_newdev} days.

sa_meetings.label: SA meetings
sa_meetings.text: Meetings with a Solutions Architect in the last {win_eng} days.

days_to_renewal.label: Days to renewal
days_to_renewal.text: Days until the current contract ends.

flags.label: Flags
flags.text: "Why now" alerts that call for action this week.

commit_at_risk.label: Commit at Risk
commit_at_risk.text: At least 25% into the contract and using commit at under {car_pace} of the expected pace.

renewal_window.label: Renewal Window
renewal_window.text: Contract renews within {renewal_days} days: time to prepare the renewal.

usage_spike.label: Usage Spike
usage_spike.text: Last 7 days ran at {spike}× or more of the 4-week average. Something new probably launched.

new_developers_flag.label: New Developers
new_developers_flag.text: {newdev_min}+ new developers in {win_newdev} days, likely a new team or project starting.

quadrant.label: Quadrant
quadrant.text: One of four boxes, from score and pool of funds, that decides the type of help an account gets.

fde_deep_engagement.label: FDE Deep Engagement
fde_deep_engagement.text: High score and big pool of funds: worth hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer time.

scaled_sa_program.label: Scaled SA Program
scaled_sa_program.text: High score but a small pool of funds: help through shared office hours and templates.

strategic_bet.label: Strategic Bet
strategic_bet.text: Big pool of funds but a low score: targeted exec and SA discovery to find the opening.

digital.label: Digital
digital.text: Low score and a small pool of funds: docs, webinars and community.

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.text: How many accounts the SA/FDE team can actively cover. Today: the top {capacity} by expected value.

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.text: Whether the account is inside the top {capacity} that get dedicated help.

motion.label: Motion
motion.text: The type of help the account gets, decided by its quadrant and capacity.

program.label: Program
program.text: Which burn-recovery program applies: the Commit Burn Sprint, FDE-led recovery, or the holdout group.

holdout.label: Holdout
holdout.text: {holdout_share} of Sprint accounts, picked at random and measured but not enrolled, so we can prove the program's real effect.

goal.label: Goal
goal.text: The one outcome this engagement is working toward.

owner.label: Owner
owner.text: The person accountable for the engagement's next step.

status.label: Status
status.text: On track, At risk or Blocked, judged by the owner each week.

blocker.label: Blocker
blocker.text: What is stopping progress right now, if anything.

next_step.label: Next step
next_step.text: The single next action, ideally with a date.

engagement_health.label: Engagement health
engagement_health.text: Share of active engagements that are on track, at risk or blocked.

tier.label: Tier
tier.text: Package size of the services offer.

scope.label: Scope
scope.text: What the services team delivers in this tier.

indicative_price.label: Indicative price
indicative_price.text: Illustrative list price for the tier, not a quote.

deals_per_year.label: Deals / yr
deals_per_year.text: How many of this tier we expect to sell in a year.

services_revenue.label: Services revenue
services_revenue.text: Price × deals per year: revenue from the services themselves.

pull_through.label: Consumption pull-through
pull_through.text: Extra yearly platform usage after the migration, the bigger prize than the services fee.

jd_keyword.label: Role keywords
jd_keyword.text: Phrases from the job description that this part of the prototype demonstrates.

responsibility.label: Responsibility
responsibility.text: A duty listed in the job description.

built.label: What we built
built.text: The part of this prototype that demonstrates that duty.

page.label: Page
page.text: Where to see it on this site.

step.label: Step
step.text: One stage of the lifecycle, from raw data to measured impact.

explanation.label: Simple explanation
explanation.text: What happens at this step, in one plain sentence.

segment_region.label: Region
segment_region.text: Sales region: AMER, EMEA, APAC or LATAM.

treated.label: Enrolled
treated.text: Sprint accounts that get the program, compared against the holdout.

money_in_play.label: Money in play
money_in_play.text: Total pool of funds across all accounts: unused commit plus open pipeline.

accounts_count.label: Accounts
accounts_count.text: Number of customer accounts in the group.

layer.label: Layer
layer.text: Stage of the data, like a warehouse: raw, processed, output, site.

file.label: File
file.text: Where that layer lives in the project folder.

holds.label: What it holds
holds.text: What one row or record in that file contains.

group.label: Group
group.text: Enrolled accounts get the program; holdout accounts are measured only.
